The only STOP condition is meeting the\n    performance threshold or being unable to improve.\n\n    Args:\n        problem_size (tuple): The dimensions of the 3D problem grid that was just run (e.g., Px, Py, Pz).\n        topology (tuple): The 3D process topology of the MPI ranks used for the run (e.g., nx, ny, nz).\n        total_instance_cpu (int): The total number of physical CPU cores available in the entire instance.\n        total_instance_memory_gb (int): The total amount of system RAM, in Gigabytes, available in the entire instance.\n        cores_per_node (int): The number of physical CPU cores on a single compute node.\n        threading_hint (int): Specifies the level of SMT/Hyper-Threading to assume (e.g., 1 for no SMT, 2 for SMT).\n        current_fom (float): The measured \"Figure of Merit\" (FOM) from the completed run.\n        executable_command (str): The base command string for the AMG executable, excluding problem size and topology.\n        threshold (float): The performance goal, as a fraction of the theoretical maximum FOM. Defaults to 0.90.\n        ideal_fom_per_core (float): A hardware-specific tuning constant for the max FOM of a single core. Defaults to 4.5e8.\n        efficiency_sweet_spot (float): A tuning constant modeling communication overhead (DOFs/rank for ~76% efficiency). Defaults to 1.0e6.\n        retry_scale_factor (float): The multiplier used to increase problem dimensions on a RETRY. Defaults to 1.5.\n        dofs_per_gb (float): A tuning constant for the memory model (DOFs that fit in 1 GB of RAM). Defaults to 1.2e7.\n        memory_safety_factor (float): A safety margin for memory usage (e.g., only use 95% of available RAM). Defaults to 0.95.\n    Returns:\n        (dict): A dictionary containing 'decision', 'reason', and 'resources'.\n    \"\"\"\n    px, py, pz = problem_size\n    nx, ny, nz = topology\n    total_dofs = px * py * pz\n    total_ranks = nx * ny * nz\n    max_ranks_on_node = cores_per_node * threading_hint\n    num_nodes_in_instance = total_instance_cpu / cores_per_node\n    memory_gb_on_node = total_instance_memory_gb / num_nodes_in_instance\n\n    if total_ranks == 0:\n        next_params = {\"problem_size\": problem_size, \"topology\": (1,1,1)}\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": \"Topology cannot be zero.\",\n            \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": 1, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n        }\n\n    if total_ranks > max_ranks_on_node:\n        suggested_topology = _suggest_balanced_topology(max_ranks_on_node)\n        next_params = {\"problem_size\": problem_size, \"topology\": suggested_topology}\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": f\"Topology of {total_ranks} tasks exceeds the single-node limit of {max_ranks_on_node}. Suggesting smaller topology.\",\n            \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": max_ranks_on_node, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n        }\n\n    max_dofs = memory_gb_on_node * dofs_per_gb * memory_safety_factor\n    if total_dofs > max_dofs:\n        suggested_problem_size = _suggest_problem_size_from_dofs(max_dofs)\n        next_params = {\"problem_size\": suggested_problem_size, \"topology\": topology}\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": f\"Memory constraint violated. Suggesting smaller problem size to fit on one node.\",\n            \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": total_ranks, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n        }\n\n    cpu_per_rank = max_ranks_on_node // total_ranks\n    total_cores_used = total_ranks * cpu_per_rank\n    dofs_per_rank = total_dofs / total_ranks\n    scaling_efficiency = math.tanh(dofs_per_rank / efficiency_sweet_spot)\n    effective_fom_per_core = ideal_fom_per_core * scaling_efficiency\n    theoretical_max_fom = effective_fom_per_core * total_cores_used\n\n    if theoretical_max_fom < 1e-9:\n        return {\"decision\": \"STOP\", \"reason\": \"Theoretical max FOM is zero.\", \"resources\": None}\n    \n    performance_ratio = current_fom / theoretical_max_fom\n\n    if performance_ratio >= threshold:\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"STOP\", \"reason\": f\"Current FOM {current_fom:.2e} is at {performance_ratio:.1%} of theoretical max {theoretical_max_fom:.2e}. Threshold met.\",\n            \"resources\": None\n        }\n\n    next_problem_size = (int(px * retry_scale_factor), int(py * retry_scale_factor), int(pz * retry_scale_factor))\n    next_total_dofs = next_problem_size[0] * next_problem_size[1] * next_problem_size[2]\n\n    if next_total_dofs > max_dofs:\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"STOP\", \"reason\": f\"Performance {performance_ratio:.1%} is below threshold, but next larger problem exceeds single-node memory. Best achievable performance found.\",\n            \"resources\": None\n        }\n    next_params = {\"problem_size\": next_problem_size, \"topology\": topology}\n    return {\n        \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": f\"Performance {performance_ratio:.1%} is below threshold. Suggesting larger problem size.\",\n        \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": total_ranks, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n    }\n"

dockerfile
# Base image for CPU environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set environment variables to enable non-interactive installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies, MPI, and certificates for amg2023
# The --no-install-recommends flag is used to reduce image size
# libgomp1 is explicitly installed as requested
# Clean up apt cache to keep the image layer small
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary build directory
WORKDIR /tmp

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 source code, build it,
# copy the executable to a system path, and clean up the source code
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git && \
    cd AMG/test && \
    make && \
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/AMG

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments
# Allow running as root, which is common in containers
# Enable oversubscription to allow more processes than CPU cores, useful for testing/dev
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Set the default working directory for the container
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command to run the application
CMD ["amg"]

# Base image for CPU environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set environment variables to enable non-interactive installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies, MPI, and certificates for amg2023
# The --no-install-recommends flag is used to reduce image size
# libgomp1 is explicitly installed as requested
# Clean up apt cache to keep the image layer small
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary build directory
WORKDIR /tmp

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 source code, build it from the root directory
# to ensure all dependencies are compiled, copy the executable to a system path,
# and then clean up the source code to minimize image size.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git && \
    cd AMG && \
    make && \
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/AMG

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments
# Allow running as root, which is common in containers
# Enable oversubscription to allow more processes than CPU cores, useful for testing/dev
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Set the default working directory for the container
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command to run the application
CMD ["amg"]

flux-minicluster-manifest
# This MiniCluster manifest has been updated to run a larger, 32-task job.
# It incorporates all valid corrective actions from the entire debugging history,
# including a corrected command based on the latest instruction's clear intent.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of our MiniCluster instance for this experiment.
  name: amg2023-cpu-test
  # Deployment will occur in the 'default' namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's Indexed Job.
  size: 1
  # FIX: The number of tasks is increased to 32 as per new instructions.
  tasks: 32

  # Pod specification to target appropriate hardware.
  pod:
    # FIX: A nodeSelector is added to target c6a.16xlarge instances for the larger run.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: c6a.16xlarge

  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # FIX: The command is updated for 32 tasks on an 8x4x1 grid with a small problem size,
      # correcting the contradictory values in the latest instruction based on its intent.
      command: amg -problem 2 -P 4 4 4 -n 8 4 1
      # This container is the application workload, not the launcher.
      # Setting this to false is a mandatory requirement.
      launcher: false

      environment:
        # Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the definitive, corrected value to resolve linker errors.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /mnt/flux/view/lib:/mnt/flux/view/lib64:/usr/lib64
        # Constrain each MPI task to a single OpenMP thread to avoid oversubscribing CPUs.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the manifest.

# This MiniCluster manifest represents the culmination of a full debugging cycle.
# It is configured to run a 32-task job on a specific node type and includes
# all valid corrective actions, such as the definitive library path and command.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of our MiniCluster instance for this experiment.
  name: amg2023-cpu-test
  # Deployment will occur in the 'default' namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's Indexed Job.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks is set to 32 as per the scaling instruction.
  tasks: 32

  # Pod specification to target appropriate hardware.
  pod:
    # A nodeSelector is used to target c6a.16xlarge instances for the larger run.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: c6a.16xlarge

  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # FIX: The command is updated to the final corrected version, with a processor
      # grid (8x4x1) that matches the 32 tasks and a valid small problem size (4x4x2).
      command: amg -problem 2 -P 4 4 2 -n 8 4 1
      # This container is the application workload, not the launcher.
      # Setting this to false is a mandatory requirement.
      launcher: false

      environment:
        # Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the definitive, corrected value to resolve linker errors.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /mnt/flux/view/lib:/mnt/flux/view/lib64:/usr/lib64
        # Constrain each MPI task to a single OpenMP thread to avoid oversubscribing CPUs.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the manifest.
    strict: true

  # Set to false to keep pods and logs for debugging after the job completes.
  cleanup: false

# This MiniCluster manifest has been updated to resolve a pod scheduling failure.
# It incorporates all valid corrective actions from the entire debugging history,
# including a new instance type, task count, and MPI topology.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of our MiniCluster instance for this experiment.
  name: amg2023-cpu-test
  # Deployment will occur in the 'default' namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's Indexed Job.
  size: 1
  # FIX: The number of tasks is adjusted to 24 to match the new instance type.
  tasks: 24

  # Pod specification to target appropriate hardware.
  pod:
    # FIX: The nodeSelector is changed to 'r6a.12xlarge' to fix the scheduling failure.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r6a.12xlarge

  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # FIX: The command's MPI topology is updated to '-n 6 4 1' to match the 24 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -P 4 4 2 -n 6 4 1
      # This container is the application workload, not the launcher.
      # Setting this to false is a mandatory requirement.
      launcher: false

      environment:
        # Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the definitive, corrected value to resolve linker errors.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /mnt/flux/view/lib:/mnt/flux/view/lib64:/usr/lib64
        # Constrain each MPI task to a single OpenMP thread to avoid oversubscribing CPUs.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the manifest.
    strict: true

  # Set to false to keep pods and logs for debugging after the job completes.
  cleanup: false

# switching to an available ARM-based instance type. It incorporates all valid
# corrective actions from the entire debugging history.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of our MiniCluster instance for this experiment.
  name: amg2023-cpu-test
  # Deployment will occur in the 'default' namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's Indexed Job.
  size: 1
  # FIX: The number of tasks is adjusted to 48 for the new instance type.
  tasks: 48

  # Pod specification to target appropriate hardware.
  pod:
    # FIX: The nodeSelector is changed to 'r7g.12xlarge' to fix the scheduling failure.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r7g.12xlarge

  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # FIX: The command's MPI topology is updated to '-n 8 6 1' to match the 48 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -P 4 4 2 -n 8 6 1
      # This container is the application workload, not the launcher.
      # Setting this to false is a mandatory requirement.
      launcher: false

      environment:
        # Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the definitive, corrected value to resolve linker errors.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /mnt/flux/view/lib:/mnt/flux/view/lib64:/usr/lib64
        # Constrain each MPI task to a single OpenMP thread to avoid oversubscribing CPUs.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the manifest.
    strict: true

  # Set to false to keep pods and logs for debugging after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
